deadline.value: Preferred fall deadline is January 15; the department pre-application is on its Chemistry PhD site.

gre_general.value: GRE General scores are not required for admission but are welcomed.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are not required for admission but are welcomed

gre_subject.value: The chemistry pages do not mention the Chemistry GRE subject test.

supervisor.value: The pages do not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Most PhD students get a teaching assistantship in the first year, then a research assistantship from their research director.
funding.quote: Typically, you will receive a teaching assistantship for your first year in the Ph.D. program

entry_route.value: A master's is not needed to apply for the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Application for the Ph.D. program doesn't require attainment of M.S.

toefl_min.value: Department minimum is 88 on the internet-based TOEFL (pre-2026 scale).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL: Minimum score of 88 for internet-based tests

ielts_min.value: Department minimum is an IELTS overall of 7.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS International Academic Course Type 2: | Minimum score of 7

english_waiver.value: Only an American degree or a degree from an English-official country waives the test; an Indian degree does not.
english_waiver.quote: If you have a degree from an American college or university or if you are from a country where English is an official language, an English proficiency exam is not required

notes: Department's TOEFL and IELTS minimums override the Graduate School's rules. Stipend figures on the financial page are for 2023-2024 entrants.
